title: Good Ziplock bag organizer ruined by etched in company logo; also back has a crack; PRICEY
text:
Good Ziplock bag organizer ruined by etched in company logo; also back has a crack; PRICEY. This is what could have been a good four-compartment organizer for different types of Ziplock bags (quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack) except that the vendor label is etched into the bamboo just like the bag labels are etched into the bamboo. This is a BIG NEGATIVE for me as it makes the unit look like garbage. Second, there is a crack along the backboard of the unit (see photo).

This organizer opens via a hinge from the clip in the front so that the bags can be loaded easily in addition to being able to load them through the holes. This can be hung on the wall or be placed in a drawer that is large enough to hold it. Rubberized circles are provided which I installed. This keeps this from sliding around or scratching a drawer or wall. Three screws with plastic mollies are also provided for hanging.

Overall, this is a good organizer that does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets. I would have rated this 4 stars but the vendor name etched into the bamboo, the crazy price, as well as the crack in the back, has me taking off two additional stars. The vendor label irks me the most as the crack is small. They should have a removable stick-on label on the back instead if they need to advertise their product. Also, the current price of $39.99 is also ridiculously expensive. In fact, this price is about $10 more than comparable units sell for on the market.

There are many other Ziplock bag organizer options available such as this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For a more modern look, I recommend this [[ASIN:B09WN5PZ6Q one]] or an individual heavy plastic set like [[ASIN:B09THNTBGX this]]. For a cheaper unit that has room for foil and plastic wrap, then I highly recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]] but no screws are provided with that one. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires. I personally like these other ones a lot better than this one.
